verdict.rationale: Bolt has a dedicated tokens support page. It explains that direct edits in Code view use no tokens and that extra tokens can be purchased, and community users confirm a free token allowance that runs out with use. The evidence does not show what each action costs or what each plan includes, and one user's report of burning 10M tokens suggests consumption can be hard to anticipate. Missing for 10: per-action token cost breakdown, documented plan tiers and their inclusions, in-product usage visibility.
